data.name: Ikrama
data.gender_notes: Ikrama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who brings joy and delight to others. The name Ikrama carries the meaning “Delight, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Ikrama usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To inspire happiness and joy in others
data.etymology: Ikrama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikrama total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: إكرامة
in_arabic.meaning: إكرامة تعني التكريم و الرفعة و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: إكرامة هو اسم مشتق من كلمة كرم، ويعني التكريم و الرفعة و العزة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفجر الآية 17: 'وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ وَالوَدْقِ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسَعَ وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ وَذَا صَدَقٍ وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ قَلِيلٍ مِّنَ الْغَثَّاءِ وَلا كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ الرَّونَقِ إِنَّهُ لَزُلالٌ مِّن رِّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

in_urdu.name: اکرامہ
in_urdu.meaning: اکرامہ کا مطلب ہے عزت دینا، بلند کرنا، اور کرم کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکرامہ ایک نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے لفظ 'كرم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں عزت دینا، بلند کرنا، اور کرم کرنا. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر خاص طور پر کیا گیا ہے.

in_hindi.name: इकरामा
in_hindi.meaning: इकरामा का अर्थ है सम्मान देना, ऊँचा करना, और दया करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इकरामा एक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'كرم' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान देना, ऊँचा करना, और दया करना. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका विशेष महत्व है.

in_pashto.name: إكرامہ
in_pashto.meaning: إكرامہ دى عزت ورکړى، لوړ کړى، او کرم ورکړى
in_pashto.long_meaning: إكرامہ دى يو نوم دى چى د عربي کلمې 'كرم' څخه اخستى دى، چى معنى يې دى عزت ورکړى، لوړ کړى، او کرم ورکړى. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو تر منځ ډير مشهور دى او د اسلامي دود په منځ کې يې خاص اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Ikrama
in_english.meaning: Ikrama means honor, dignity, and generosity in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Ikrama is an Arabic name derived from the root 'K-R-M', which signifies honor, dignity, and generosity. In Islamic tradition, Ikrama holds a significant importance as it relates to the values of respect, nobility, and benevolence. The name Ikrama has been mentioned in various Islamic texts and is associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, courtesy, and magnanimity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ikrama holds a beautiful cultural significance as it conveys a sense of positivity, kindness, and delight. Ikrama is a name that describes a person who has the ability to uplift and bring joy to those around them. This name is particularly important in Islamic culture where kindness, generosity, and compassion are highly valued virtues.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ikrama means much more than just a joyful or delightful person. It is a reminder of the inherent goodness that exists within each and every one of us. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Allah does not look at your faces and your bodies but He looks at your hearts and your deeds." (Bukhari and Muslim). Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Ikrama is to constantly strive towards bringing joy and happiness to others, and in doing so, reflecting the mercy and compassion of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delight, pleasure" symbolizes A person who brings joy and delight to others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ikrama serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delight, pleasure.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ikrama ibn Abi Jahl was a prominent Meccan polytheist and a leader of the Quraysh tribe during the early years of Islam.
historical_references.context: Ikrama was a prominent figure in pre-Islamic Mecca and opposed the spread of Islam.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ikrama remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
